material.acceptance_criteria: Row net-e2e-two-peers unblocked by an explicit ownership decision on js/host/frame.js and js/client/frame.js, and a pinned relay dependency version.
material.description: Facts at remote main 7db475cd605b81f6a0b73b9bc327b7050b5048da: (1) js/host/frame.js encodeState emits tick/units/hash only, no positions; js/client/frame.js decodeState expects u32 id, f32 x, f32 z, u8 player per unit. (2) js/host/frame.js decodeFrame reads order as int32 x,y; js/client/frame.js encodeOrderMove writes f32 x,z. (3) js/wire/frame.js (the intended replacement, other lane) is not imported by either side. (4) The guest exposes unit-position <id> -> 'ok unit-position x y' and order <unit> x y (rust/crates/wasip1/src/lib.rs), so positions are obtainable host-side. (5) play.html needs pkg/web.js and map.bin in the served dir; no CI job builds js/client/pkg. (6) js/host/package.json has no WebSocket server dependency for a local relay. Fixing (1) and (2) requires editing js/host/frame.js and js/client/frame.js, which are outside this row's ownership list. Options for the orchestrator: widen ownership to those two codec files, or assign the codec to js/wire lane first.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-2-13-v1 at e03ee19: js/wire/frame.js and js/client/wire/frame.js byte-identical; STATE carries id, kind, player, x, y, hp; node js/wire/test.js 'wire frames ok types=7 roundtrip=14'; CI run 39065835817 success; browser-two-peers job (ci.yml:2776) success.
